trap_found:
OLLAMA_HOST is very commonly spelled BARE (127.0.0.1, gpu-node) and the daemon
supplies port 11434 itself in that case. My first resolver read the value literally, producing
http://127.0.0.1 — port 80 — on this very machine, where the variable is set that way. That
would have turned honouring the variable into a NEW way to probe the wrong place: the defect
relocated rather than removed. The resolver now fills the port in when omitted, pinned by
test_bare_host_env_keeps_the_daemon_default_port.
